$comment: 每月依賴新鮮度檢查用：已經看過、但這次不調整宣告的決定。deferredLatest 記下當時審視的版本，PyPI 一超過它就自動恢復提醒。

scrapling.reason: Install resolves to 0.5.1. Checked offline against the 0.5.1 wheel (2026-11-21; the 0.5.0 check was 2026-10-28): the StealthSession keys headless/network_idle/timeout/proxy moved to a new _BrowserSession base TypedDict but are still accepted by StealthyFetcher.fetch, StealthyFetcher still inherits the BaseFetcher.adaptive attribute, and Selector.css still takes auto_save. 0.5.1 only adds RemoteSession and parser fixes; nothing here needs it, so the >=0.3.0 floor (the release that introduced adaptive/auto_save) stays. No live fetch was run.

scrapegraphai.reason: Install already resolves to 2.3.1.
